balls.text: Patel misses a run out chance, tries to kick the stumps and misses that too. He is a jolly fellow, grinning as he goes off. Kochi have done a superb restriction job here.
yorker length and dug out, that's the most Ravi can do
Oh dear, oh dear. Whats is going on? Mishra wants to play the paddle, but misses and Ravi Teja has already screamed down to the stiker's end. Mishra sacrifices himself.
yorker, in the block hole, Christian is looking to loft it over long-on but drags it onto his stumps instead.
driven beautifully, but it will just be the one, sweeper cover is out there
Christian swinging and lobs it over cover in the end, only gets one
it doesn't end the way RP would have wanted it to. Ravi Teja, down on one knee, swings that past short fine leg and beats deep square
full again and dug out to long on
straying down leg, first mistake from RP tonight
full and wide, carved away and good running ensures two
backs away and the ball follows him, good seam movement and RP stops the leg bye
slightly wider and Teja reaches for it, before tapping it to point
full ball, driven to long on
driven to long off, Christian keeps strike.
looking for the sweep again, can't get it away, Mishra was down the track awaiting the single, not on
guided to short third man
driven to long on
looking to sweep that, but ends up hitting into his boot
turned to mid-wicket, Christian off the mark

two in two for Vinay. Slower ball, Sanga looking to cut that and gets a faint edge through to Pathiv Patel who collects cleanly. Sanga out for 65, after surviving that peach of a ball from Sree when he was on six.

swatted and swatted straight to deep mid-wicket. Jayawardene has put himself there to collect the catch, good captaincy. White was looking for the big pull but didn't get enough on the ball and it went straight to Jayawardene.
making some decent contact here, is White, hit hard past Sanga and gets his pad on the way, just the two
pulled to deep mid-wicket, not quite short enough to give that the treatment
fuller ball, White backs away and wants to tonk it over long on but gets a bottom edge down the pitch, just the one
back of a length and pulled to the man at deep mid-wicket. There's a man covering that area
driven to long off, Sree finishes wicketless but with decent figures
too cute from Sanga, moves across a little, picks that up on welll and flicks to fine leg, in the air for a while and its a clever little paddle scoop
driven to long off, Sree tries to get his leg in the way to field it, but he lets one through
White makes room for himself, drives on the off side, two bounces and four
wants to heave ho that over long off, but can't get it away and ends up playing it onto the pitch, single taken
Sanga wants to run it to third man but gets a bottom edge and it's four
White wants to try the paddle, but defends
square driven to deep cover
Sanga brings up fifty with a fine stroke to fine leg, paddle sweep and plenty of cheers for this fine innings. He was bowled off a no-ball on six, remember?
played to Sree at long off whose fumble allows the second
flat and short, cut to cover
slower delivery, pushed to long off
dabbed down to long off, good over for the Chargers
now he gets four. Cut away and there's no stopping it this time. Jadeja at backward point can only watch
Sree! Superb fielding in the deep to cut off a boundary, Sanga drives square and it looked certain for the rope. Sree gets it from underneath him to save a boundary
upper cut for four. Sanga does well to go the aerial route, there's no third man and its a welcome boundary
good length, offers a little more width and White plays that along the ground to mid-on
tucked away on the leg side, looking for the run but they decide not to
played to deep extra cover, hard running to ensure the two
driven to long on
picked like a cherry. White frees the arms, goes down on his knee and clobbers it over square leg.
Sanga mishits that to long off, luckily its not in the air for long enough and the fielder can't get there
slower ball, White looks to heave away, only gets one
full and flat, played wide of long on
this time the slower ball doesn't work. Short ball and flicked into the gap at fine leg
slower ball and keeps very low indeed. Sanga was swinging knee high but it was too low and there's no contact made
straying a little on the leg side, whipped away, Sanga loves that shot and its through midwicket for four
driven with a little more purpose, down to long off
White is looking for trouble, tips that to point and he's off for the run, had the fielder hit, he would have been gone as White is sent back
slower ball, Sanga gets an inside edge as he tries to pull and it trickles to fine leg
No bounce off that one, White gets beaten, surprised by how low it kept
White goes on the pull too, very awkward looking as he is offered a short ball, mistimes through mid-wicket, but he gets four
driven to long off
short and Sanga doesn't let these goes. Pulls through mid-wicket, small adjustment needed because of the extra bounce, but he gets four
great length, pushed past the bowler and just gets it past the man at mid-off to run through for one
Sanga is a good long way down the track, flicks to deep mid-wicket
White backed away for that one and only managed to dab it tamely back to Gomez, who got a finger on it and brok the stumps at Sanga's end. Sanga is safe
strike rotation seems better now, played to long on
whipped to deep mid-wicket, length ball
driven to long on
it's go for it time, boom, says Danny. White gets that quite high bat, in the air between long off and long, a lot of effort for one
angling into middle and leg, played to midwicket
run down to third man, there's protection there, and it's just the one
swinging in again, White gets a leading edge to long off and Sanga pushed him for the second. Direct hit might have seen Sanga out
just too good! What a beaut. Inswinger, comes into White and almost, almost takes off stump out of the ground.
pushed into the off-side, not too much in the way of timing for White
moving away slightly, White swings and misses, totally out of touch
Perera is introduced now. Sanga steers that down to third man
superb ball again, stays straight and beats White's outside edge
good length and steered down to third man
decent line and length, probably not of the pullable type, but White tries anyway, gets off the mark as the ball rolls to deep mid-wicket
worked to deep square leg
superb swing. Moves away sharply from Sanga, gets the outside edge and flies between the keeper and first slip. Patel made a desperate attempt to take it but couldn't
Sanga's started to dance. Comes down the track, tucks one leg behind the other and smokes it to deep extra cover
straighter and pushed back to Sree, who has bowled a maiden. Not a bad comeback at all.
straight and good length, defended on the off side
and now he almost gets White. Moves in this time and is oh so close to the edge
and again, away movement, superb outswinger and left alone
Sree still getting good shape, White dabs to point
good length, shapes away and left alone
good length and pushed into the off side
full delivery, Sanga shoulders arms and lets it through
good line and length, defended with the full face of the bat down to the bowler
great movement, swings away from Sanga who leaves alone
Can't keep Sree out of the action, can you? Chipli looks to work the ball through mid-wicket but closes the face of the bat too early and chips it up in the air. Simple catch for Sree at mid-off.
back of a length, Sanga looks to drive square but gets a bottom edge to third man
away swing and it's just out of Chipli's reach, he plays and misses
full and straight, driven down the pitch, not too far
tucked away to mid-on, quick single taken
appeal for lbw good length and Chipli inside edges onto his pads, umpire says no immediately. replays show it was pitching outside leg
width offered and Chipli cuts but can only get it as far as the fielder on the ring
full and driven to mid on
much better, beats the bat and ends the over, what a mixed bag from the Kerala Express
oh gosh Sree! Now he has lost it. That one is swinging too far away and it's called wide
good line and length and dabbed back to Sree
full now and that goes between Sanga's legs as he tries to clip away on the leg side
Sree seems pretty angry and now he has bowled it too high and it's a no-ball again, this time for height
what a response Sree. Changes the length, not as short as the last one, it's swinging in and Sanga inside edges it onto his stumps. But wait, it looks like a no-ball, Umpires are checking.
just stunning, That's short and inviting and Sanga rolls out the pull shot in stunning fashion. He picked the spot and drilled it there
straight delivery, Sanga can't do much except tap it back to Sree
back of a length, dabbed to the off side
dropped  Driven in the air to Brendon McCullum in the covers. He chests the ball instead of catches it and the Chargers will breathe a massive sigh of relief
turned to mid-wicket, nicely timed for the single
stroked through the covers. Perera gives chanse and gets to the ball but is saves it just beforeit goes over. The umpires check and its given as three runs
back of a length, moving into Chipli and he is rapped on the pads

what a superb catch by Gomez. Dhawan tried to get under that full delivery and did but his lofted shot didn't have the distance on it. Gomez had to run from mid-off to deep extra cover and took the catch over his shoulder.
run down to fine leg
slower ball, Chipi trying to steer to third man, gets a slight edge and it doesn't carry
Finally, they get a run. Driven back to Sreesanth who fields well off his own bowling and they sneak a single while the ball rolls to mid-off
Big appeal for caught behind  Dhawan tries to cut and misses. Patel was up in a flash for the outside edge but it's not given
now he goes full, Sree and Dhawan drives back to him. The crowd go mad for Sree
And again. Dhawan is trying to get that away on the leg side but he can't make contact
short of a length, Dhawan can't squeeze it away
and success! RP goes fuller and Sohal goes back and across to try and get it away on the leg-side but gets struck flush on the pad. That was going to hit middle no doubt.
moves into Sohal and there's some good shape there. Tries to dab it onto the leg side and run a quick one but can't
short and down the leg side, wide called
keeps Sohal on the back foot, defends into the off side
back of a length again, Dhawan is cramped up, squeezes it out on the off side, quick single taken
beautiful carry, goes through waist high, left alone by Dhawan
RP starts proceedings with a back of a length ball, nips back a touch, bit of bounce, there's some glove on that and a run

All over. Steyn finished with two wickets in two balls. Yorker length and RP was backing away and that came off his pad to dislodg the bail. Comprehensive win for the Chargers, who looked dead and buried mid way through their innings and came back with a bowling performanace that was simply phenomenal.

Goner! That's a full, straighter one, held it's line and there was very little Vinay Kumar could have done about that. Offstump is castled and the end is near. Jayawardene looks increasingly glum in the pod
decent length, bit wide of offstump and Vinya swings and misses
looking to cut, gets a bottom edge down onto the pitch and it's brealk time again
turned to short fine leg
launches but doesn't launch far enough. Down on one knee, slog sweeps that to Christian at deep mid-wicket who collects on the boundary
pushed back to the bowler
Jadeja chargs down the track, tees off and mishits that to short third man, gets a leading edge that doesn't carry
last over for Mishra, pushed away on the off side
full again and steered away to third man, looks for a second but its not there
wide and Vinay has to reach for it, can only nudge it past point
full and inviting the drive, Vinay Kumar wants to but gets an outside edge that runs down to third man
back of a length again and shapes away a touch, before carrying to Sanga
a little bit more width on offer here, driven to deep cover
back of a length, pushed into the covers
ends the over with a googly, played to point
nice and fine, that was a topspinner, strayed on leg stump line and hits the pad to trickle to fine leg, just two
swatted onto the on-side, no boundary in this over yet
driven along the ground to mid-on
and again, this time he gets it away for a single on the leg side
googly, comes out of the back of the hand beats Vinay Kumar
goes short this time and Vinay Kumar has to fend it off with his elbow, its in the air for a while but lands safely and they take one
pitched up and Vinay Kumar goes for it. Driven in the air between midwicket and long off and gets four
bouncer, takes off and almost takes Vinay Kumar's head off
fuller and defended with a straight bat, down the pitch
short, wide and sliced away to deep point, just the one
turned to mid-wicket
tapped into the off side, they scramble through for the one
driven in the air to cover
small nudge to mid-wicket, Mishra fields off his own bowling
almost identical, driven to long on
tossed up a little, driven to long on and the 50 comes up. Nine more avoids being bowled out for the lowest total
clipped into the covers, small misfield allows for the one
swing and a miss from Jadeja, what can he do now with the writing so starkly on the wall?
back of a length, comes off the outside edge and goes past all the slips for a single
and we're back into wicket mode. Perera tries to pull that and he is hurried into the stroke. It ends up going to cover and Cameron White takes the catch.
back of a length, worked through the covers
good bounce, shorter ball and Jadeja wanst to upper cut but can't make contact
steered down to third man
nudged into the off side, good start for the spinner
flat ball, pushed off the back foot to mid off
out comes the googly, surprises Perera who pushes it back to Mishra but doesn't carry
down the leg side, Perera wants to flick away but misses
turned around on the leg side
defended on the front foot, good stride in
slower ball, keeps low and Perera wants to slice it through the off side but misses a third in a row
And he is still swinging, that one was there to be hit, short and wide but he misses
short of a length, Perera plays and misses
full delivery, pushed out to the covers
carved to deep extra cover
too far outside off
played in the air to point
that surprises Perera, extra bounce, rises on him as he tries to fend it off with one hand
short ball, Perera gets under it and lofts it to long on, almost looked as though he would be challenging the fielder there, but it bounces safely
pushed to mid-off
back of a length, pushed off the back foot into the covers, Jadeja looking quite solid for these last two balls
smacked past Gony for four. Jadeja on the charge, he was nicely down the track and had a full go at that
Gony comes in and starts with a fuller ball, outside off, pushed to point
tucked away to midwicket, they run hard for the two
off the outside edge, flies past backward point, looked as though it had gone straight to him but Jadeja survives
that one holds it line and beats the bat, almost an outside edge
swings away again, Jadeja watching this go past
moves away and left alone
back of a length and defended off the back foot
goes for the bouncer this time, Perera ducks and it's a wicketless over for Ishant
driven past mid-off, who gets a hand on it, but can't stop the boundary, massive cheer for those runs
back of a length, climbs on Perera who tries to get it away on the on side but can't
fuller ball, driven to short cover, well fielded by Ravi Teja
outside edge again
Perera couldn't wait to get off strike, dabbed that down and raced through
in the air to mid-wicket, comes off an edge it seems and Perera gets one
no end to this over yet, wide outside off
brushes the pad on the way through to Sanga, down the leg side again
Steyn goes wayward, short and down the leg side, signalled wide
nudged into the covers and there are thoughts of a single, but decided against
off the outside edge again, past a diving White at second slip, maybe Sanga should think of a third slip here
squirted off the outside edge, runs down to third man, Jadeja looks totally puzzled, no foot movement, just a push
tapped down into the off side, a dozen runs scored, half a dozen wickets down

And it is a mobile number indeed, one with a five in for Sharma. Jayawardene walks, as Sanga catches his best mate out. Steep bounce on offer and Sharma bowls a good length, climbs on Jayawardene and he gets an edge through to Sanga.
back of a length, tapped into the on side and a quick single taken
threaded through past point, Jadeja stays back in the crease and gets this one away
fuller ball, driven into the covers, an unexciting delivery for a change
Stunning movement again, Jadeja could easily have nicked that one, lucky not to

Sharma! You Superstar! Straight delivery and traps Jadhav on the front pad, just on the roll and it's not too tough to call this out. Jadhav is the fifth batsman to depart for a duck in Kochi's innings.
Now Jayawardene gets hold of one, width offered again and he square drives that for four, into the gap. That's the first runs off the bat
terrific length, Jayawardene can only dab down to defend
wide and Jayawardene should have hit that, but he defends into the pitch
Jayawardene not wanting to play at this one, lots of away movement
Beats the bat this time
Jayawardene, who has just witnessed carnage, defends that off the back foot
that ends a very eventful over, still no runs off the bat. Swings away, Jadav watches it.
this is is a terrific display from Ishant. Fuller delivery, Hodge has no idea what has hit him, but he knows iits hit his stumps. No footwork at all, the ball slants in and bowls him.
moves across Hodge, too far across and goes down the leg side, called wide
Good delivery, swinging away but there's no need for Hodge to play at that and he doesn't
yowza! Ishant Sharma is on fire. Kept low and drew the Gomez onto the front foot but snuck through him and cleaned him up.
oh my goodness! The seam movement is just stunning and its the extra bounce is what gets Patel. He has a prod and is caught behind. Deccan right back in this, suddenly 130 looks like 150.
Angling across Jayawardene, trickles off the pads and the first run is a leg bye
takes off, swings away this time, Sanga has it covered and Steyn starts with a maiden
as expected, swings into Patel and he tries to flick away on the leg side, but doesn't make proper contact
But the word makes no difference. McCullum pokes at one that shapes away, no footwork at all, gets the outside edge and Sanga has to dive forward to take it. Early breakthrough for the Chargers
Another wild swing and a miss, this one a bit close to off stump. He is beaten and Jayawardene goes over to have a word, perhaps about being reckless
McCullum flashing hard, it's still swinging away and he misses completely
Immediately, he gets the away swing, McCullum leaves alone, two slips in place for Steyn
